brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 3x hex-acc-keyhole accessories on rear faces: accessory:0#0,0#1 (0,0,0 slot1), accessory:0#1,0#1 (1,0,0 slot1), accessory:0#2,0#1 (2,0,0 slot1). Horizontal 3-cell bar (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full + piece:2,0,0;full) distributes load across 3 screws.

requirements.requirement: With hooks for small hand tools
requirements.evidence: 6x hex-acc-hook plates (two hooks per plate = 12 hooks) on front/outside faces: accessory:0#0,0#2, accessory:0#1,0#2, accessory:0#2,0#2 on slot 2 and accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4, accessory:0#2,0#4 on slot 4. Connected/locked row with connectors and jointBolts provides rigid rail for tools.

finish.summary: 3-cell horizontal wall rail (0,0,0 + 1,0,0 + 2,0,0) with 3 keyhole hangers on the wall side and 6 Hook-plate accessories (12 hooks) on the front faces. Connectors and jointBolts lock the cells; caps close open faces and joints are locked. The configurator's hook mount only accepts cable coil / gaffer tape / FPV goggles as props, so small hand tools cannot be staged hanging in the viewer, but the physical Hook plates provide the requested tool hooks; real-world load, wall fixings and material strength are not verified by the configurator.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
